, USR_MENU_INFO AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN CL.LABEL IS NULL THEN MM.MENUNAME ELSE CL.LABEL END AS MENULABEL , (CASE WHEN MM.URI IS NOT NULL THEN '['||A.MENUID||']'||MM.MENUNAME ELSE MM.MENUNAME END) AS MENUNAME , CASE WHEN MM.URI IS NOT NULL THEN 'PRG' ELSE 'FLD' END AS PRGFLG , MM.URI --, MM.SORTORDER , A.* FROM ( SELECT LEVEL AS LVL , Z.* FROM ( SELECT ML.COMPID , ML.MENUID , ML.PMENUID , ML.SORTORDER -- , MM.MENUNAME AS MENU_NM -- , MM.MENULABEL AS M_LABEL -- , MM.URI -- , MM.SORTORDER FROM MSTMENUG MG --메뉴 그룹정보 JOIN MSTMENUGL ML --메뉴 그룹별 메뉴할당정보 ON ML.COMPID = MG.COMPID AND ML.MENUGID = MG.MENUGROUPID AND ML.MENUGID != 'MBL' JOIN ( SELECT MENUID FROM USR_MENU GROUP BY MENUID ) USR_MN ON ML.MENUID = USR_MN.MENUID WHERE 1=1 AND MG.COMPID = 'KN' AND MG.MENUGROUPID = 'DEV' AND MG.DELETEYN = 'N' /*AND ML.DELETEYN = 'N'*/ ) Z START WITH PMENUID = 'root' CONNECT BY PRIOR MENUID = PMENUID --ORDER BY SORTORDER ) A LEFT JOIN MSTMENU MM --메뉴 마스터 ON MM.COMPID = A.COMPID AND MM.MENUID = A.MENUID LEFT JOIN SYSLABEL CL ON CL.LABELGID = 'MENU' AND CL.LABELID = MM.MENULABEL AND CL.LANGCODE = 'KR' WHERE MM.DELETEYN = 'N' --ORDER BY A.SORTORDER ) -- SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USR_MENU_INFO; -- SELECT * FROM USR_MENU_INFO; -- SELECT -- LPAD(' ', 3 * (LVL-1)) || MENULABEL AS DEPT_KR_NM, -- A.* -- FROM USR_MENU_INFO A;

SELECT MAS013.PROC_NM AS PROCESS --공정명 , MAS012.MACH_NM AS MACH_NM --설비명 , MAS030.MGMT_ITEM_CD AS MGMT_ITEM_CD --관리항목코드 , MAS030.MGMT_ITEM_NM AS MGMT_ITEM_NM --관리항목명 , MAS030.MGMT_DEPT_ID , MAS018.DEPT_KR_NM AS MGMT_DEPT_NM --관리부서명 , FN_CD_VAL('UNIT', MAS030.UNIT) AS UNIT --단위 , MAS031.BUSI_PLN_AMT AS BUSI_PLN_GOALS --목표(사업계획량) , 0 AS BUSI_PLN_PRFM --실적 , 0 AS BUSI_ACH_RATE --달성율 , MAS031.EXCTN_PLN_AMT AS EXCTN_PLN_GOALS --목표(실행계획량) , 0 AS EXCTN_PLN_PRFM --실적 , 0 AS EXCTN_ACH_RATE --달성율 --, TST.BUSI_PRFRMNCE --, DECODE(MAS031.BUSI_PLN_AMT, 0,0, TST.BUSI_PRFRMNCE*100/MAS031.BUSI_PLN_AMT) BUSI_ACHVMNT_RATE --, TST.EXCTN_PRFRMNCE --, DECODE(MAS031.EXCTN_PLN_AMT, 0,0, TST.EXCTN_PRFRMNCE*100/MAS031.EXCTN_PLN_AMT) EXCTN_ACHVMNT_RATE FROM TB_MAS031 MAS031 --설비별 목표 설정정보 JOIN TB_MAS030 MAS030 --설비별 목표 항목정보 ON MAS030.PLN_YR = MAS031.PLN_YR AND MAS030.WERKS = MAS031.WERKS AND MAS030.MACH_CD = MAS031.MACH_CD AND MAS030.MGMT_ITEM_CD = MAS031.MGMT_ITEM_CD JOIN TB_MAS012 MAS012 --설비코드 ON MAS012.MACH_CD = MAS030.MACH_CD JOIN TB_MAS013 MAS013 --공정마스터 ON MAS013.PROC_CD = MAS012.PROC_CD LEFT JOIN TB_MAS018 MAS018 --부서정보 ON MAS018.DEPT_CD = MAS030.MGMT_DEPT_ID AND ROWNUM = 1 --ON MAS018.COMPKY = MAS030.COMPKY --AND MAS018.DEPT_CD = MAS030.MGMT_DEPT_ID --LEFT JOIN ( -- SELECT 0 BUSI_PRFRMNCE, 3 EXCTN_PRFRMNCE FROM DUAL --) TST --테스트 코드 --ON 1=1 WHERE 1=1 AND MAS031.PLN_YR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AND MAS031.PLN_MM = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'MM')

/* qryId - Common.DASHBOARD_PRD_STAT_LIST */ SELECT BASE.WERKS AS PLANT , DECODE(MAS013.PROC_CD, 'CB', DECODE(UNIT, 'R', MAS013.PROC_NM || ' 예외', MAS013.PROC_NM), MAS013.PROC_NM) AS PROCESS , UNIT --, BASE.PRFM_DT , SUM(NVL(CASE WHEN BASE.PRFM_DT < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM') || '01' THEN BASE.WGT ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS PRV_MNTH --PRE_MNTH_WGT_SUM , SUM(NVL(CASE WHEN BASE.PRFM_DT > TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,-1)), 'YYYYMMDD') THEN BASE.WGT ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS THIS_MNTH --CUR_MNTH_WGT_SUM , SUM(NVL(CASE WHEN BASE.PRFM_DT = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') THEN BASE.WGT ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS VRY_DAY --CUR_DAY_WGT_SUM FROM ( SELECT WERKS, MACH_CD, PRFM_DT, UNIT , NVL(DECODE(UNIT, 'KG', WGT, 'PLT',PLT_QTY, 'BOX',BOX_QTY, 'BAG',BAG_QTY, 'EA',EA_QTY, 0), 0) WGT FROM TB_WRK001 --실적테이블(HL) WHERE PRFM_DT BETWEEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,-1), 'YYYYMM') || '01' AND TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(SYSDATE), 'YYYYMMDD') AND NVL(CNL_YN, 'N') = 'N' AND PRFM_GTHR_YN = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT WERKS, MACH_CD, PRFM_DT, UNIT , NVL(DECODE(UNIT, 'R', PCNT, 'KG',WGT, 'EA',PRFM_QTY, 0), 0) WGT FROM TB_WRK002 --실적테이블(PS) WHERE PRFM_DT BETWEEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,-1), 'YYYYMM') || '01' AND TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(SYSDATE), 'YYYYMMDD') AND NVL(CNL_YN, 'N') = 'N' AND PRFM_GTHR_YN = 'Y' ) BASE JOIN TB_MAS012 MAS012 --설비코드 ON MAS012.MACH_CD = BASE.MACH_CD JOIN TB_MAS013 MAS013 --공정마스터 ON MAS013.PROC_CD = MAS012.PROC_CD GROUP BY BASE.WERKS, MAS013.PROC_CD, MAS013.PROC_NM, UNIT ORDER BY BASE.WERKS, MAS013.PROC_NM, UNIT

SELECT BASE.WERKS AS PLANT , MAS013.PROC_NM AS PROCESS , BASE.UNIT -- , BASE.PRFM_DT , SUM(NVL(CASE WHEN BASE.PRFM_DT < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM') || '01' THEN BASE.UCFMTY_AMT ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS PRV_MNTH --PRE_MNTH_UCFMTY_AMT_SUM , SUM(NVL(CASE WHEN BASE.PRFM_DT > TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,-1)), 'YYYYMMDD') THEN BASE.UCFMTY_AMT ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS THIS_MNTH --CUR_MNTH_UCFMTY_AMT_SUM , SUM(NVL(CASE WHEN BASE.PRFM_DT = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') THEN BASE.UCFMTY_AMT ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS VRY_DAY --CUR_DAY_UCFMTY_AMT_SUM FROM ( SELECT WRK001.WERKS, WRK001.MACH_CD, WRK001.PRFM_DT, QLT024.UCFMTY_AMT , WRK001.UNIT FROM TB_QLT024 QLT024 --부적합 처리 정보(부적합 실적) JOIN TB_WRK001 WRK001 --실적테이블(HL) ON WRK001.WERKS = QLT024.WERKS AND WRK001.IND_BCD = QLT024.IND_BCD AND WRK001.LOT_NO = QLT024.LOT_NO AND WRK001.MATNR = QLT024.MATNR WHERE WRK001.PRFM_DT BETWEEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,-1), 'YYYYMM') || '01' AND TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(SYSDATE), 'YYYYMMDD') UNION ALL SELECT WRK002.WERKS, WRK002.MACH_CD, WRK002.PRFM_DT, QLT024.UCFMTY_AMT , WRK002.UNIT FROM TB_QLT024 QLT024 --부적합 처리 정보(부적합 실적) JOIN TB_WRK002 WRK002 --실적테이블(PS) ON WRK002.WERKS = QLT024.WERKS AND WRK002.IND_BCD = QLT024.IND_BCD AND WRK002.LOT_NO = QLT024.LOT_NO AND WRK002.MATNR = QLT024.MATNR WHERE WRK002.PRFM_DT BETWEEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,-1), 'YYYYMM') || '01' AND TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(SYSDATE), 'YYYYMMDD') ) BASE JOIN TB_MAS012 MAS012 --설비코드 ON MAS012.MACH_CD = BASE.MACH_CD JOIN TB_MAS013 MAS013 --공정마스터 ON MAS013.PROC_CD = MAS012.PROC_CD GROUP BY BASE.WERKS, MAS013.PROC_NM, BASE.UNIT ORDER BY BASE.WERKS, MAS013.PROC_NM, BASE.UNIT

/* qryId - Common.DASHBOARD_DISPO_STAT_LIST */ SELECT WERKS AS PLANT
, CASE WHEN WERKS = 'P300' OR WERKS = 'P500' THEN 'EA' ELSE UNIT END AS UNIT , DISPO_DIV --, DISPO_CD , SUM(NVL(CASE WHEN PRFM_DT < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM') || '01' THEN WGT ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS PRV_MNTH --PRE_MNTH_WGT_SUM , SUM(NVL(CASE WHEN PRFM_DT > TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,-1)), 'YYYYMMDD') THEN WGT ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS THIS_MNTH --CUR_MNTH_WGT_SUM , SUM(NVL(CASE WHEN PRFM_DT = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') THEN WGT ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS VRY_DAY --CUR_DAY_WGT_SUM FROM ( SELECT WRK004.WERKS, WRK004.PRFM_DT, WRK004.DISPO_CD, WRK004.UNIT , NVL(DECODE(WRK004.UNIT, 'KG',WRK004.WGT, 'EA',WRK004.DISPO_QTY, WRK004.DISPO_QTY), 0) WGT , MAS023.DISPO_NM AS DISPO_DIV --SELECT WERKS, PRFM_DT, DISPO_CD, DECODE(NVL(WGT, 0), 0, DISPO_QTY, WGT) AS WGT FROM TB_WRK004 WRK004 --폐품 실적(PS, HL(합지기)) LEFT JOIN TB_MAS023 MAS023 --폐품(불량)항목 관리 ON MAS023.DISPO_CD = WRK004.DISPO_CD AND MAS023.WERKS = WRK004.WERKS WHERE PRFM_DT BETWEEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,-1), 'YYYYMM') || '01' AND TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(SYSDATE), 'YYYYMMDD') AND NVL(CNL_YN, 'N') = 'N' UNION ALL SELECT WERKS, PRFM_DT, '' AS DISPO_CD, UNIT , NVL(DECODE(UNIT, 'KG',DISPO_WGT, 'EA',DISPO_QTY, DISPO_QTY), 0) WGT , '가공폐품' DISPO_DIV --SELECT WERKS, PRFM_DT, DISPO_CD AS DISPO_CD, DECODE(NVL(DISPO_WGT, 0), 0, DISPO_QTY, DISPO_WGT) AS WGT FROM TB_WRK016 --폐품등록현황(HL) WHERE PRFM_DT BETWEEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,-1), 'YYYYMM') || '01' AND TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(SYSDATE), 'YYYYMMDD') AND NVL(CNL_YN, 'N') = 'N' ) --GROUP BY WERKS, DISPO_CD, UNIT GROUP BY WERKS, DISPO_DIV, UNIT ORDER BY WERKS, DISPO_DIV
SELECT LOC_CD, PCNT, WGT FROM TB_INV017 WHERE BASE_DT = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE -1, 'YYYYMMDD') ORDER BY BASE_SEQ

SELECT WRK003.WERKS AS PLANT --플랜트코드 , MAS020.ABN_NM AS TYPE --유형(비가동원인명) , SUM(NVL(CASE WHEN WRK003.ABN_DT < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM') || '01' THEN WRK003.ABN_TM ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS PRV_MNTH --PRE_MNTH_WGT_SUM , SUM(NVL(CASE WHEN WRK003.ABN_DT > TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,-1)), 'YYYYMMDD') THEN WRK003.ABN_TM ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS THIS_MNTH --CUR_MNTH_WGT_SUM , SUM(NVL(CASE WHEN WRK003.ABN_DT = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') THEN WRK003.ABN_TM ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS VRY_DAY --CUR_DAY_WGT_SUM FROM TB_WRK003 WRK003 --비가동이력(비가동 실적) -- LEFT JOIN TB_MAS012 MAS012 --설비코드 -- ON MAS012.MACH_CD = WRK003.MACH_CD JOIN TB_MAS020 MAS020 --비가동 항목 ON MAS020.ABN_CD = WRK003.ABN_CD AND MAS020.WERKS = WRK003.WERKS WHERE WRK003.ABN_DT BETWEEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,-1), 'YYYYMM') || '01' AND TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(SYSDATE), 'YYYYMMDD') --AND WRK003.CNL_YN = 'N' AND WRK003.IN_OUT IN ('I','N') AND NVL(WRK003.CNL_YN,'N') != 'Y' GROUP BY WRK003.WERKS, MAS020.ABN_NM ORDER BY WRK003.WERKS, MAS020.ABN_NM

SELECT WRK011.WERKS AS PLANT --플랜트코드 , MAS013.PROC_NM AS PROCESS --공정 , MAS012.MACH_NM AS MACH_NM --설비명 , MAS020.ABN_NM AS RSN --사유(비가동원인명) , TO_CHAR(WRK011.ABN_DTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS OCCR_TIME --발생시간(비가동 시작시간) --, TO_CHAR(WRK011.ABN_DTM, 'MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI') AS OCCR_TIME --발생시간(비가동 시작시간) , ROUND( (SYSDATE - WRK011.ABN_DTM)*24*60) AS LAPSE_TM --경과시간(분) -- , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(WRK003.ABN_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MI') AS OCR_DT FROM TB_WRK011 WRK011 --작업장(설비)별 현재 진행현황 LEFT JOIN TB_MAS012 MAS012 --설비코드 ON MAS012.MACH_CD = WRK011.MACH_CD LEFT JOIN TB_MAS013 MAS013 --공정마스터 ON MAS013.PROC_CD = MAS012.PROC_CD LEFT JOIN TB_MAS020 MAS020 --비가동 항목 ON MAS020.ABN_CD = WRK011.ABN_CD AND MAS020.WERKS = WRK011.WERKS WHERE 1=1 -- AND (WRK011.ABN_DTM IS NOT NULL OR WRK011.ABN_CD IS NOT NULL) AND WRK011.ABN_DTM IS NOT NULL AND WRK011.ABN_CD IS NOT NULL ORDER BY WRK011.WERKS , MAS013.PROC_NM , MAS012.MACH_NM , MAS020.ABN_NM
